definitions.gloss: flurry of falling petals, shower of blossoms
definitions.explanation: A poetic term for cherry blossom petals scattering in the wind like a snowstorm. One of the most evocative images of spring in Japanese culture, symbolizing both the peak beauty and the transience of the cherry blossom season.

examples.japanese: {花吹雪|はなふぶき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}っていた→舞う：04573_mau⟧。
examples.english: Cherry blossom petals were swirling like a blizzard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{花吹雪|はなふぶき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{包|つつ}んだ→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: When the wind blew, a shower of petals enveloped the park.

examples.japanese: {川面|かわも}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{花吹雪|はなふぶき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぎ→降り注ぐ：07976_furisosogu⟧、⟦{水面|すいめん}→水面：04307_suimen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ピンク→ピンク：04718_pinku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まった→染まる：04254_somaru⟧。
examples.english: A blizzard of petals rained down on the river surface, dyeing the water pink.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (flower, especially cherry blossom) and ⟦{吹雪|ふぶき}→吹雪：00040_fubuki⟧ (blizzard/snowstorm). The metaphor compares the dense scattering of cherry petals to a snowstorm. This is specifically a spring image — it refers to the moment when cherry trees shed their petals en masse.

{花吹雪|はなふぶき} is a seasonal word (⟦{季語|きご}→季語：09561_kigo⟧) for late spring in haiku. It evokes both beauty and the Japanese aesthetic of {儚|はかな}さ (transience).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花吹雪|はなふぶき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}う→舞う：04573_mau⟧: petals dance like a blizzard
- {花吹雪|はなふぶき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧: petals fall like snow
- ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{花吹雪|はなふぶき}: cherry blossom blizzard
